CustomField.description: Semicolon separated Emirates IDs permitted to sign while Signing_Is_Production__c is false. Anyone not listed is refused before any callout. Blank means nobody, not everybody, because envelopes land in Modon's live DocuSign account. Ignored once Signing_Is_Production__c is true. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Signing Allowed Emirates Ids
